audits.resolution_reason: Midpoint-only notch support teaches a geometry template that fails accepted off-center canonical inputs; selected Racket and 24 generated plus three canonical controls are retained. Audited source unchanged.
audits.text:
## 0e134ade0f09

**A1: Midpoint-only notch placement admits a geometry template that fails accepted canonical inputs.** Findings only; the audited generator and shared sources were left unchanged.

**Source binding.** Generator SHA-256 `e1fe9b0d7bcb3e0ed14f44f2d72172759eb104670b6f27b6a0a2d86e93671ab1`, version `2.1.0`; canonical/executed rule hash `71fca8698886`; executed rule-text SHA-256 `2551b778aee2b440995d8f6612c8ef73cadf9cbfc9f645f432774e34d6c579b5`. The public apply receipt reports catalog approval false and matching executed/catalog rule hashes. Current associated notes were read; no task-local `evidence/review_index.json` exists.

**Mechanism and consequence.** `_edge_center` always chooses the integer midpoint of a rectangle edge. `generate` uses it for every primary notch and places additional notches only on the opposite edge of the same rectangle. The rival in `checks/audit/0e134ade0f09/probe.py` finds foreground connected components, computes their bounding boxes, and checks only the four edge midpoints for a background plus. It paints each such plus with the corresponding frame-edge color. It does not inspect any of the five-cell directional ring patterns. This geometry template answers the tested generator draws exactly but misses valid off-center notches. The four declared semantic rivals do not include this surviving template, so their one-demo identifiability result does not establish identification against this plausible alternative.

**Measured evidence.** The probe used seeds `820000..820023`, sample indices `0..23`, cycling `easy`, `medium`, `hard`; exact overrides alternate `n_notches=4` and `n_notches=8`. All 24 generated inputs passed `self_check` and `strict_canonical_like`; their observed dimensions and exact overrides are in `cases.json`. The same batch included the three distinct canonical inputs obtained through `reviewer_support.canonical_pairs` (six stored pairs, three distinct inputs). All three canonical inputs also passed both validators. Public Racket apply returned 27 valid outputs with no per-input errors. The midpoint rival matched **24/24 generated outputs** and **0/3 canonical outputs**, disagreeing by respectively 25, 5, and 25 cells on canonical variant 0 train pairs 0 and 1 and test pair 0. The source structure explains why the midpoint restriction extends beyond these 24 measured samples; no exhaustive seed claim is made.

**Minimal witness.** Canonical variant 0, train pair 1, input index 25 in `input.json` (also retained as `minimal_input.json`) has a left-facing notch centered at zero-based `(7,17)` in a component with bounding box `(4,17,13,26)`. Its left-edge midpoint is `(8,17)`, so the rival fails to fill the real notch. At `(7,17)` the rival leaves background color **4**, while Racket returns frame-left color **3**. `minimal_witness.json` retains the complete input, rival output, authoritative output, acceptance and source binding. This witness is on the accepted canonical-like domain, rather than an intentionally malformed input outside the teaching grammar.

**Recommended task-local repair.** Vary notch offsets along edges, including off-center positions with the required ring margin; allow compatible neighboring-edge notches and a wider spread of rectangle geometry. Add this independently implemented midpoint template to semantic/lesson rivals and retain canonical pair 1 as a regression witness. Ensure routine generated lessons refute it. `probe.py` is a reusable task-local audit proposal, not a source change.

**Reproduction.** From the packet's outer `review/` folder, run:

```sh
python3 review.py run python3 ../checks/audit/0e134ade0f09/probe.py
python3 review.py run python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 0e134ade0f09 --input ../checks/audit/0e134ade0f09/input.json --out ../checks/audit/0e134ade0f09/racket.json
python3 review.py run python3 ../checks/audit/0e134ade0f09/probe.py --summarize
```

The apply output path must be new on a fresh replay. Exact command arrays, cwd, exit codes and evidence paths are in `checks/audit/0e134ade0f09/commands.json`; compact measured results are in `summary.json`. Scope was this one structural shortcut, 24 targeted draws and all three distinct canonical inputs. No full battery, assignment draws or solve-file inspection were performed.
